ModMetadata.Name: Serial Terminal
ModMetadata.Author: etareduction
ModMetadata.Description:
Adds the Norsec TTY-6 Serial Terminal: a free-standing computer block - monitor, desk unit and keyboard - that is secretly just a glass teletype. No processor, no storage: your IC10 circuits print to it and read typed input from it through a classic 6-register memory-mapped UART (get/put). Click the screen to type; every keystroke goes straight to the wire.
IC10 quick reference (device d0): put d0 0 char - print one ASCII character put d0 1 str - print a packed string, e.g. put d0 1 STR("HELLO ") get r0 d0 0 - pop next typed keystroke (0 if none; Enter=13, Backspace=8) get r0 d0 2 - characters waiting put d0 3 1 - clear screen (2 flush input, 4-7 transfer modes, 8/9 local echo) put d0 4 row / put d0 5 col - move the cursor; get reads it back Control codes: 8 BS, 10 LF, 12 FF, 13 CR, 127 rubout, 133 newline (CR+LF). Logic: Setting (write packed string), Quantity (input waiting), Error (input overflow), Color.
Local echo (put d0 3 9) makes typing paint the glass instantly, no circuit needed. Memory is volatile: power-cycling the terminal wipes screen, buffer and modes. Full API: API.md in the mod folder.
